reference.title: Bog File Protection tool
reference.shortdesc: The Bog File Protection tool allows you to enter, change, or add a bog file passphrase.

section.p:
The .bog file uses encoding that does not allow you to save changes to password values from . This tool permits to perform the following:
Enter the file's passphrase.
Start protecting the file with a passphrase.
Change the file's passphrase.
Revert station to be compatible with releases prior to .
Remove all users except for one superuser. The user will use the configured password.
Force the file to start using a different passphrase that you specify. Any password values that are encoded with the current passphrase will be cleared.
Force any password values that depend on the current file protection to be cleared.
